card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 46 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 3.7 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, SS Sct: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 45.6 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,394 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
